name: team_planning_cut_budget_line
description: Cut a budget line from a scenario of a Team Planning plan, by budget_line_id from team_planning_budget_lines. The scenarios that follow lose it too. Setting the line again brings it back. Refused on the baseline, which holds the organisation's approved budget, and unless the caller is one of the plan's editors. `note` is Markdown: links, **bold**, _italic_, lists and `code` render, a bare URL becomes a link, typed HTML shows as text and images render as links.

note.description: Why this is in the plan, such as the business reason for a move. Optional, at most 2000 characters; it never changes what the scenario resolves to. A note on a change to a person goes when they are forgotten. Any other note, such as one on a unit, a position or a rule, stays until the plan is deleted, so keep personal details out of it.

scenario_id.description: The scenario. The baseline is refused.
